scraperConfig.analyzerNotes: This is a company-specific job listing page on jobup.ch for Swissquote Bank SA showing 5 job postings. The page uses React rendering (requires JS). Each job card is wrapped in a div with data-cy="serp-item". The company name is not displayed within individual job cards since this is a company-specific page. Location is extracted from the first grid item containing a location icon. Posted date is in the header section of each card. No salary information or description snippets are visible in the listing cards. No pagination is present - all 5 jobs are displayed on a single page. The site uses utility-first CSS classes making selectors somewhat verbose but stable via data-cy attributes and structural patterns.
